body: Lia, may policy-design signal dito na worth bantayan, pero hindi ko pa tatawaging trend from this measure alone: support is being structured as preserving future pension credit habang binabawasan ang current childcare cash burden. If similar designs appear across more family/social-insurance measures, saka natin masasabi na may broader shift toward protecting both present cash flow and long-term entitlement. One dot is policy; three dots, saka ilabas ang trend line.
